agentName.label: Agent name
agentName.help: Used when the agent introduces itself. Leave blank to stay unnamed.

dba.label: DBA name
dba.help: The trade name the receptionist announces. Leave blank to use your account name — billing and invoices always keep the account name.
dba.helpWithName: The trade name the receptionist announces. Leave blank to use your account name ({{name}}) — billing and invoices always keep the account name.

greeting.label: Opening greeting
greeting.help: First thing callers hear. Use {{agentToken}} and {{businessToken}} as placeholders.
greeting.placeholder: Hello! Thank you for calling. How can I help you today?

context.label: Business context
context.help: Plain text is fine. The more detail, the better the agent performs.

bookingAlert.label: Text me when an appointment is booked
bookingAlert.help: Your own mobile. The receptionist texts you the appointment as soon as it books, so you don't have to be watching the app. Leave blank for no text.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Connect Google Calendar so the receptionist books into your real calendar and only offers times you're actually free.
calendar.notConfigured: Google Calendar isn't configured on the server yet. Until it is, bookings use HelmSmart's built-in calendar.

hours.title: Business hours
hours.description: The receptionist only books inside these hours.

appointmentTypes.title: Appointment types
appointmentTypes.description: What the receptionist can book — each with a duration so the calendar slot is right.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.description: Products, services, pricing, policies, FAQs — what the receptionist answers from. If it isn't here, the agent takes a message instead of guessing.
knowledge.contentPlaceholder: What should the receptionist know about this?

setup.title: Receptionist setup
setup.description: Everything below must be set for the agent to answer and book.

items.numberFix: Enter the number callers dial in the box above, then point that number at us in your carrier console.
items.hoursFix: Set open days and times in the Business hours section below.
items.typesFix: Add at least one service (with a duration) in Appointment types below.
items.agentFix: Turn on the AI Voice Agent toggle above.
items.calendarFix: Connect Google Calendar below to only offer times you're actually free.
items.calendarFixUnconfigured: Optional — connect a calendar to avoid double-booking.

setup.verifyHint: Confirms Retell has your number bound to the agent with the inbound webhook.
setup.verifyOk: Wired correctly — agent and inbound webhook confirmed in Retell.
setup.verifyMissing: Number found, but {{missing}} isn't set right in Retell.

manual.step1: On your Retell number, under Inbound Call Agent, set the shared agent.
manual.step2: Check “Add an inbound webhook” and paste the URL below, replacing the key with your RETELL_FUNCTION_SECRET.
manual.step3: Point each custom function at the function URL.
manual.note: Use the www URLs exactly as shown — the bare domain redirects and Retell won't follow it on a POST.

number.label: Your phone number
number.help: The number callers dial. Point it at the platform in your carrier console, then enter it here.
number.wiredOk: Saved and wired — the agent will answer this number.
number.savedNotAnswering: Saved, but not answering calls yet
number.notInProvider: This number isn't in the voice provider yet.
number.notAttached: It isn't attached to the receptionist agent.
number.webhookWrong: Its inbound webhook doesn't point here.

wizard.connectedBody: It's wired to your agent automatically. Finish the checklist below, then call it to test.
wizard.buyHint: We'll buy a number and wire it to your receptionist automatically. Billed at about $2/month.
wizard.importHint: Already have a number? Connect it via its Twilio SIP trunk — we'll wire the agent for you.
